svg.title: BSGO Private Server
svg.desc: GAME SERVER, OPEN SOURCE. Battlestar Galactica Online closed in 2019 and its game data was never published. This rebuilds it: a generator that emits 12,250 cards across 58 star systems and checks each one against the server's own source, on top of the open-source BSGOCore server with persistence, protocol and combat fixes. Playable end to end with the original client. Java, JavaScript, Python. github.com/Gurnski/BSGO-Private-Server
